fato_historico: 1944: World War II: The USS Shark (SS-314) was lost with all 87 hands in the Bashi Straits after torpedoing the Japanese freighter Arisan Maru.
energia_do_dia: Today may invite a deep reflection on resilience and the flow of life. Just as the ocean depths carry ancient stories of courage and quiet sacrifice, you might feel a gentle pull to honor your own journey. It is a good time to navigate your emotions with grace and consider how every small experience shapes your brave spirit.
frase_do_dia: In the quietest depths of your soul, you discover your greatest strength and light.
significado_numero: A powerful reminder of collective strength and the beauty of human connection.
conselho: Trust the current of your intuition and move forward with an open, hopeful heart.
